# Base-retail AI actor constructor golden

Whole original1DFB90,16B840,1E4990 and1A80E0 output, with actual NULL cold callbacks.
The BSP index, clock and counter are supplied live owners. This covers cold
actor records/identity only, not unit binding, perception, AI behavior or gameplay.
The baseline plus byte deltas reconstructs every original0x888-byte result.

Regenerate with `.tools/python/bin/python tools/oracle_ai_actor_constructor_base.py`
using a fresh `--output-dir` and `--fixture tests/fixtures/source_ai_actor_ctor_base.md`.
The tool enforces the shared serial 64 MiB measured ceiling and zero swap.
